name: Kiryuu Misao
source:
Kaoru's arch-enemy and Nanao's right-hand woman.

On the surface, she is known as a “responsible disciplinary committee member,” but in reality, she is a girl who bullies dull-witted people like Kaoru and Mayu.

She seems to have a younger boyfriend, whom she blindly adores and dotes on.

[Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game_character.php?game=9978]erogamescape[/url]]
